item.title: Custom Styling
item.description:
你可以从这几个地方做定制：

  1. 修改 params.headerElements 和 params.footerElements
  2. 在主题的 assets/css/custom.css 中追加样式
  3. 用 marginnote、sidenote 和 figure shortcodes 组织内容

如果你的站点是强视觉导向，也可以把首页改造成更像作品集的入口。

item.title: Monkeys vs Apes: Understanding the Difference
item.description:
When visiting a zoo or watching nature documentaries, it is easy to use “monkey” and “ape” interchangeably.

Both monkeys and apes belong to the order Primates, which includes hundreds of living species worldwide.
In fact, they describe two distinct groups with clear physical and evolutionary differences.

Great apes tend to be larger, more social, and better studied than most monkey species.

The Tail Tells the Tale

The quickest visual clue is the tail. Monkeys have tails, sometimes long and flexible, sometimes short and stubby, but they have them. Apes do not.

item.title: Iterators vs Generators in Python
item.description:
Python gives us two closely related tools for lazy evaluation: iterators and generators.

Iterator

An iterator is any object that implements __iter__() and __next__().

Generator

A generator is a compact way to build an iterator with yield.

Both are useful, but generators are often the more ergonomic default when you control the data source.
